name: Watanuki Kaede
source: A young and eccentric psychiatrist who was assigned to [url=/c6397]Masaki[/url] after the arrest of his previous one. She often chides and tries to provoke him. She seems to be really interested in [url=/c89850]Rokushiki[/url]. According to [url=/c6397]Masaki[/url], she's able to "read minds".
